🔥🇲🇽 <u>URUAPAN MAYOR EXPOSED AS “AVIADORA” — 201,501 PESOS IN GHOST CONGRESS PAY</u>

Michoacán Congress president Baltazar Gaona García (Morena) presents payroll records: Uruapan mayor Grecia Quiroz collected 201,501.80 pesos as a “legislative advisor” to deputy Carlos Tafolla between September 19, 2024 and June 30, 2025 — while simultaneously running DIF Uruapan as honorary president, with public events on the record. The Internal Comptroller of the Legislative Branch is now opening an administrative investigation; restitution is demanded. The opposition plays victim on national TV while their officials quietly double-dip; 4T transparency tools are catching it on the record.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>OXFAM IN CONTRALÍNEA MX: GAZA CEASEFIRE IS FAILING — 1,300 DEAD, 250 CHILDREN</u>

Oxfam International’s Bushra Khalidi, in conversation with Mexico’s Contralínea: “Gaza is being divided again.” Seven months after UN Security Council Resolution 2803, the basic ceasefire objectives are unmet — more than 1,300 people killed since October 10, 2025 (250 of them children), 70% of Palestinians without adequate housing, 1.1 million children without reliable water, zero fully operational hospitals. UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher: “silencing the weapons is not enough; dignity must be restored.” Mexico’s position remains: two-state solution, end the genocide, recognize Palestine.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>LA GRAN ESCAPADA: 114,000 TOURISM OFFERS, 6,577 ESTABLISHMENTS, ALL 32 STATES</u>

Sectur’s second annual “Buen Fin” of tourism opens with 35% average discounts, 5% more experiences and 11% more establishments than 2025’s inaugural edition — and for the first time foreign tourists can buy in. Secretary Josefina Rodríguez Zamora: the strategy “looks to incentivize internal tourism” and steady seasonal volatility. Sheinbaum: “the promotions aren’t limited to traveling this weekend.” Firefly tours in Tlaxcala, artisan workshops, community-led routes — the 4T’s bet on domestic demand and small operators instead of all-inclusive enclaves.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>CNTE LIFTS ZÓCALO PLANTÓN AFTER 19 DAYS — STRIKE IN RECESS</u>

National teachers’ assembly votes to enter “reorganization phase” and lift the CDMX encampment after 19 days. Oaxaca’s Sección 22 — the most militant base — swung 12,818 to 3,594 in favor of the recess after SEP put an economic bonus on the table. Secretary Yenny Aracely Pérez says the struggle exposed “the lack of a dignified retirement system” and the unfulfilled promise to repeal the 2007 ISSSTE Law — dialogue with Segob and SEP continues. The fight isn’t over; it’s being repositioned.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>GUARDIAN: SHEINBAUM IS THE WORLD’S MOST POPULAR LEFTIST LEADER</u>

The British paper’s front-page feature “Yo, Claudia” by Rachel Nolan calls Sheinbaum “one of the most popularly democratically elected leaders in the world” with a 70% approval rating — “standing out against the wave of conservative and far-right leaders elected in the Americas in recent years.” A scientist who is the disciplined face of the Cuarta Transformación, and a model the gringos still don’t know how to attack without exposing themselves.

📉🇲🇽 BANXICO Q1: ECONOMY CONTRACTED IN EVERY REGION — NORTH HIT WORST BY TARIFFS

Banxico Regional Economies Report (Jun 16): GDP -0.62% q/q. North and south -1.0% each. Northern manufacturing -1.5% (the region holds 41.7% of national manufacturing GDP). Center-north manufacturing -1.3%. Construction -2.2%. Tourism -1.1% — only the south expanded, on city and beach destinations.

Only one bloc broke through the weakness: the center grew +0.9% in manufacturing, propped up by World Cup confectionery production. Banxico names T-MEC review uncertainty as the central drag — Trump's tariff war priced in to every region. Sheinbaum's answer: internal market, diversification, and Plan México as the post-export bulwark.

🚨🇲🇽 GARCÍA LUNA'S "ZODIACO" CASE COLLAPSES — VALLARTA WALKS AFTER 20 YEARS

First Collegiate Court of Toluca unanimously confirmed Israel Vallarta Cisneros' acquittal. He spent 20+ years in Altiplano max-security after a December 2005 arrest by Genaro García Luna's AFI — described in the ruling as "a televised setup broadcast nationally that generated significant irregularities in the justice system."

Judge Mariana Vieyra Valdez: no evidence exists to incriminate him. Vallarta on release: "I needed 20 years to exercise my right to reply." García Luna sits in a US federal prison for narco-collaboration. The Calderón era is being dismantled, ruling by ruling, by the same judiciary the right calls illegitimate.

🔥🇲🇽 SAMUEL GARCÍA'S WALLS — NUEVO LEÓN HIDES POVERTY FOR FIFA TOURISTS

Cyclonic fencing with green covering and "welcome" banners now line Constitución, Ignacio Morones Prieto and Miguel de la Madrid avenues in Monterrey and Guadalupe — the exact routes World Cup 2026 visitors will travel. Behind the green covers: sheet metal and wooden homes. The walls were not built to protect residents. They were built to hide them.

Ruth Dávila (CIDE) calls it aporophobia coded into governance, reading David Harvey: "the wealthy class wages class war, and is winning it." The MC governor turned class fear into infrastructure. The walls are a confession written in zinc.

🇲🇽🚍 METROBÚS AT 21 — HOW CDMX BROKE THE FARE-BOX CASINO

Sheinbaum at the Metrobús 21st anniversary: the real transformation wasn't articulated buses replacing minibuses, it was killing the model where concessionaire income depended on raw passenger volume — the system that made micros race each other for fares and kill pedestrians.

Two years of negotiation with operators while she was CDMX environment secretary alongside transport secretary Francisco Garduño. No privatization shock: concessionaires became companies, drivers became salaried, the city government backed the down payments. 21 years on, still the playbook for transit sovereignty.

⚡🇲🇽 INE GREENLIGHTS MORENA DIGITAL AFFILIATION — OPPOSITION HOWLS

INE General Council approved Morena's mobile-app affiliation in a divided vote — no "foto viva" (live photo) requirement that PRI, MC and PVEM are bound by. Five counselors dissented, warning the app lacks minimum authenticity standards.

Council president Guadalupe Taddei: validating the statute does not mean validating each registration. Morena scales its digital pipeline as the 2026-2027 federal cycle opens in September. Same INE invalidated 160,000 Morena sign-ups in April — the institution still works, the panic is performative.
